description: [OPUS-4.8] sq-2e93 / sq-ixc3.6 / sq-cno90 / sq-w2sod — default capability for the sparq GUI main window: the minimal core-window permissions and a LEAST-PRIVILEGE filesystem grant scoped to the app's local-data `workspaces/` dir ONLY (durable on-disk workspace persistence, epic sq-ixc3). The fs-PLUGIN grant is path-scoped to $APPLOCALDATA/workspaces and grants no arbitrary FS. HONEST APP-COMMAND POSTURE (sq-w2sod): the Tauri capability ACL here gates only CORE and PLUGIN commands (core:/plugin:); it does NOT bind the app-defined `#[tauri::command]`s registered in lib.rs, which any webview script can invoke by name. Those are constrained IN RUST, not by this allowlist — `load_path` reads ONLY paths the user picked through the `pick_rdf_files` command (which opens the OS file dialog SERVER-SIDE and records the canonicalised selection as an unforgeable approved-path capability) and returns a single GENERIC error for any failure so it is no filesystem existence/permission oracle; `disk_usage` (sq-cno90) resolves and stays within the SAME $APPLOCALDATA/workspaces subtree, sums its files' real byte sizes, and follows no symlink out of the tree; `load_text` decodes only in-memory text the webview already holds. The pre-wired native query/update commands the frontend never called were REMOVED to shrink the invocable surface. The file dialog is now driven from Rust, so no `dialog:allow-open` grant is needed (the webview no longer invokes `plugin:dialog|open`).
